jobs.title: Senior Content Creator, Runner's World
jobs.description: We are the UK s leading premium publisher, home to iconic and influential media brands including Esquire, Men s & Women s Health, ELLE, Good Housekeeping, Harper s Bazaar, Digital Spy, Cosmopolitan, Red and more. At Hearst UK, we don t just create content – we shape culture. Our workplace is driven by passion, shaped by authenticity and powered by creativity. We back bold ideas, act with an entrepreneurial mindset and continually evolve to meet the moment – while respecting the legacy that s brought us here. We believe in each other s potential and push boundaries together to create meaningful impact, both across the media landscape and in people s lives. We re proud of our heritage – but even more excited about making history. The Role… As the Senior Content Creator, you will work alongside the Multiplatform Director to create and publish best-in-class content that drives traffic, engagement and membership. You will update the website with content, prioritising audiences such as Facebook and Google Discover. You will also be involved in shaping RW’s online content strategy and delivering exciting brand plans for the year ahead, including video content, events and membership.   Main Duties… Write and edit daily digital content across multiple touchpoints, from curated news stories to the latest training advice, ensuring RW’s distinctive voice and authority are consistently reflected. Use data and audience insights to help shape RW’s digital strategy, driving reach and engagement with our target audience, while balancing editorial excellence with commercial objectives. Work collaboratively with print, social, video, membership, events and e-commerce teams to deliver compelling cross-platform storytelling. Work specifically with the Membership Director to help support and drive sign-ups to Runner’s World Club. jobs.title: Staff Writer (Satire), the Exploit
jobs.description: Summary of the Role the Exploit ( theexploit.co ) is the security and tech industry's most trusted source of news that didn't happen. It's a satirical publication from Maze , an AI-native security company, covering the breaches, vendor launches, board meetings, AI news and compliance audits that are hilarious and totally made up, even when they don't feel like it. We're hiring two satire content creators who can write a story and then turn it into a video. Each story runs as an article on the Exploit, then becomes a short social video, usually a 30- to 90-second news segment. If you can shoot and edit the video yourself, that's a big plus. If you can't, your scripts need to be good enough that we'll happily make them for you. We'll take a great writer with no camera over a great camera with nothing to say. Two formats we like: Matt Johansen's security news recaps , where one person covers one story fast with some comedy in it, and Ev Hand , who covers sports news in the article style we're after. Some of our top articles, so you can see what works: French Locksmith Named Claude Launches Line of Padlocks; Cybersecurity Stocks Lose $18 Billion Judge Sentences CISO to 8 Consecutive Hours on RSA Expo Floor Meta Labs Proudly Announces Its AI Has Also Committed a Felony Burnt-Out CISO Forced to Decline Michelin-Starred Round Table Dinner Riot Breaks Out at Corporate Headquarters After Security Team Introduces Shift Left Your Contributions to Our Journey Writing Pitch and write 400- to 700-word articles in the deadpan voice of a real newsroom covering an unreal industry Pitch a lot of headlines and work them through with our team. The pieces are yours; we're there to keep the quality high. jobs.title: Influencer & Branded Content  Senior Manager
jobs.description: We are PMG PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Our work has earned top industry honors, including Cannes Lions and Adweek’s Media Plan of the Year, and PMG has won 40+ workplace culture awards, including being the only company to rank among Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for 11 consecutive years. Who You ll Be Working With At PMG, our Influencer & Branded Content team is at the intersection of culture, storytelling, and strategy, helping brands connect with audiences in authentic, meaningful ways. We craft high-impact influencer campaigns that go beyond traditional advertising, driving engagement, building brand affinity, and delivering measurable results across social, digital, and experiential platforms. As the Influencer & Branded Content Senior Manager, you’ll play a key leadership role in shaping and delivering influencer and creator strategies across PMG’s clients. You’ll collaborate with creators, talent agencies, media strategists, content teams, client leaders, and brand partners to develop programs that connect cultural relevance with business impact. You’ll help strengthen PMG’s influencer and creator marketing capabilities by establishing scalable best practices, developing strong talent and platform relationships, and ensuring a high standard of strategy, execution, measurement, and client service. You’ll help advance the future of branded content at PMG by identifying emerging creator trends, exploring new content formats and platforms, and translating innovation into actionable opportunities for clients.
